newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future US inflation gauge 105.2 Sept 20 week.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future US inflation gauge 105.2 Sept 20 week.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly Future Inflation Gauge (FIG) fell to 105.2 in the week ended September 20 from a revised 106.1 the previous week, ECRI said on Thursday.
A drop in the growth rates of industrial materials prices and real estate loans contributed to the decline in the inflation gauge, according to ECRI.
"After staging a very modest advance between early August and early September, the FIG has begun to retreat once again," said ECRI. "Thus the gauge is clearly pointing to a benign inflation outlook."
